## Completed the interrupted repair

**`lem-an-hp-atom-has-uniform-hp-quasinorm`** was the one item left mid-edit. I applied and extended the repair (verified mathematically before writing):

- **(b) pairing bound rewritten.** The old bound carried an unbounded factor $(1+|x_Q|/\ell(Q))^{s+1}$ and no plain size term, so it did **not** imply the stated corollary $\sup_j|\langle a_j,\psi\rangle|<\infty$ that the summation item consumes. It is now the exact min–max form
  $|\langle a,\psi\rangle|\le C\min\bigl(|Q|^{1-1/p+(s+1)/n},|Q|^{1-1/p}\bigr)\max\bigl(\|\psi\|_{L^\infty(Q)},\|\psi\|_{C^{s+1}(Q)}\bigr)$,
  with the Taylor-remainder entry and the size-bound entry both derived; one cube exponent is positive and the other negative, so the minimum is $\le1$ for every cube and the uniform-in-$j$ bound is now genuine.
- **(a) strategy corrected.** Taylor expansion now truncates at the fixed minimal order $\bar s=\lfloor n(1/p-1)\rfloor\le s$, so the page's admissible grand-maximal order $N\ge n+\bar s+1=\lfloor n/p\rfloor+1$ suffices (full order-$s$ expansion would have silently required $N\ge n+s+1$). Far decay $r^{-(n+\bar s+1)}$ and convergence $p(n+\bar s+1)>n$ unchanged in force; the outer dilate is fixed as $Q^*=\{r<C_n\ell(Q)\}$, $C_n\ge4\sqrt n$, so the remainder keeps the factor $(1+r/t)^{-N}$ in every dimension.
